## EA Media Tools 1.2.1 — ea-video

### Quality and performance

- Streaming output at the 1080p source or scale tier now uses CQ 27.
- Music Video always uses the NVENC `p4` preset, regardless of source resolution.

### Filename preservation

- Audio and music-video conversions retain the exact source filename stem.
- No converted prefix or suffix is added; only the output extension changes when required by the selected format.

### Validation

- Lint, native and compatibility TypeScript checks, 36 unit tests, and production packaging.
- Regression coverage verifies 1080p quality, Music Video NVENC preset selection, and filename preservation.

[Review all changes since v1.2.0](https://github.com/eaforlife/media-converter/compare/v1.2.0...v1.2.1).
